full_judgment: 3. On June 17, 1981 plaintiff-respondent No. 1, M/S. King Fishers Industries Ltd. filed Money Suit No. 169 of 1980 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Chittagong against defendant-respondent Nos. 2 and 3 and two others for recovery of a sum Tk. 38,75,000/- towards profit out of its joint venture with respondent No. 2, In order to secure execution of the decree which may be passed in the suit, Plaintiff-respondent No. 1 filed an application under Order 38, rule 5 of the Code of Civil Procedure for attachment of four Trawlers, namely (1) URANG CHAINAVEE-4 (BT-102,)(2) HUANG CHAINAVEE-1(BT-24), (3) SAVOR CHAINAVEE-2 (BT-16), and (4) DAUNG KAMOL (BT-11). Notice was issued upon the defendant-respondents to show-cause why they should not furnish security to the extent of the claim including the costs of the suit and failing which why the Trawlers should not be attached. An ad-interim order of attachment on the same date was passed which was to remain in force till security was furnished.
